items.t: Filings Show Trump Sold MCD and HD and Bought SpaceX Stock Instead
items.sum: A multimillion-dollar selloff in two household-name stocks and a much smaller bet on the year's biggest IPO make for a provocative filing. The White House has an explanation, and the details in the 751-transaction report test how well it holds up.

items.t: The Home Depot Declares Quarterly Dividend of $2.33
items.sum: The Home Depot®, the world's largest home improvement retailer, today announced that its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $2.33 per share. The dividend is payable on December 17, 2026, to shareholders of record on the close of business on December 3, 2026. This is the 159th consecutive quarter the company has paid a cash dividend.
